calls.statement:
-- Find the Lahti store and Interior Paint products
SELECT 
  'Store:' AS lookup_type,
  store_id,
  store_name,
  CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS sku,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS product_name
FROM dim_store
WHERE store_name LIKE '%Lahti%' AND is_current = TRUE

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'Product:' AS lookup_type,
  CAST(NULL AS INTEGER),
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR),
  sku,
  product_name
FROM dim_product
WHERE (subcategory LIKE '%Interior Paint%' OR category LIKE '%Interior Paint%' 
   OR subcategory LIKE '%Paint%' OR category LIKE '%Paint%')
AND is_current = TRUE
LIMIT 20

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  SUM(fsl.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE ds.store_id = 108  -- Lahti store
  AND dp.product_name LIKE 'Interior Paint%'
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND dd.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13
  AND fsl.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE  -- Exclude staff purchases

-- Validate the data: breakdown by product and date
SELECT 
  dd.calendar_date,
  dp.product_name,
  SUM(fsl.quantity) AS daily_quantity
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE ds.store_id = 108  -- Lahti store
  AND dp.product_name LIKE 'Interior Paint%'
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND dd.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13
  AND fsl.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
GROUP BY dd.calendar_date, dp.product_name
ORDER BY dd.calendar_date, dp.product_name
LIMIT 30

calls.statement:
-- Final validation: check totals including and excluding staff purchases
SELECT 
  'Total (excl. staff)' AS category,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fsl.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE THEN fsl.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS units,
  COUNT(*) AS line_count
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE ds.store_id = 108
  AND dp.product_name LIKE 'Interior Paint%'
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND dd.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'Staff purchases only',
  SUM(CASE WHEN fsl.staff_purchase_flag = TRUE THEN fsl.quantity ELSE 0 END),
  COUNT(CASE WHEN fsl.staff_purchase_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE ds.store_id = 108
  AND dp.product_name LIKE 'Interior Paint%'
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND dd.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13
